title: Construction Agreement: Harlow Flats Pump Station Rehabilitation and Force Main Replacement Project
fictional_notice: All parties and facts are invented.

defects.title: Progress payments due in 60 days with no interest
defects.why: Section 4.3 gives the District 60 days to pay a progress payment and bars interest on late payment. A local agency that does not pay an undisputed, properly submitted request within 30 days of receipt owes interest at the legal rate.
quotes: The District shall pay each approved Application for Payment within sixty (60) days after the District Engineer's receipt of the Application, and no interest, late charge or other compensation shall accrue or be payable on any progress payment made after that date.

defects.title: Ten percent retention
defects.why: Section 4.4 withholds 10 percent of each progress payment and 10 percent of the Contract Price in total. Retention may not exceed 5 percent of a payment or 5 percent of the contract price, and the contract recites no finding that would allow more.
quotes: From each progress payment the District shall withhold ten percent (10%) of the amount otherwise due as retention, and the total retention held by the District shall equal ten percent (10%) of the Contract Price until Final Completion.

defects.title: All subsurface risk on Contractor; no differing-site-conditions clause
defects.why: The Work includes trenches 6 to 18 feet deep and bore pits about 24 feet deep, yet Section 6.1 puts all subsurface and latent condition risk on Contractor with no price or time adjustment. A local public works contract with excavation deeper than four feet must contain the statutory differing-site-conditions clause (notice, agency investigation and change order), and this contract has none.
quotes: Contractor assumes all risk of subsurface and latent physical conditions at the Site, whether or not indicated in the Contract Documents or differing from those ordinarily encountered, including rock, groundwater, unsuitable soils and buried debris, and no adjustment of the Contract Price or Contract Time shall be made on account of any such condition.

defects.title: Time extension is the sole remedy for District-caused delay
defects.why: Section 7.4 limits Contractor to a time extension for any delay, including delay caused by the District, and waives delay damages. A clause that limits the contractor to a time extension does not bar damages for agency-caused delay that is unreasonable and was not contemplated by the parties, and a waiver of that rule is void.
quotes: An extension of the Contract Time shall be Contractor's sole and exclusive remedy for any delay, disruption, interference or hindrance from any cause whatsoever, including delay caused by the District or its consultants, and Contractor waives any claim for damages, extended overhead or other compensation on account of delay.

defects.title: Subcontractor listing only above 5 percent of the bid
defects.why: Section 8.1 requires listing only of Subcontractors above 5 percent of the total Bid and lets Contractor use unlisted Subcontractors below that level. The prime must list each subcontractor doing work worth more than one-half of 1 percent of the prime's total bid.
quotes: Contractor was required to list in its Bid only those Subcontractors who will perform work or labor or render service in an amount in excess of five percent (5%) of Contractor's total Bid, and Contractor may engage any Subcontractor below that threshold without listing or notice to the District.

defects.title: Forty-five days to supply certified payroll records
defects.why: Section 9.4 gives Contractor 45 days to furnish certified payroll records and says no penalty applies within that period. Certified payroll records must be supplied within 10 days of a written request, with a penalty of $100 per worker per day after that.
quotes: Contractor shall furnish a certified copy of the payroll records to the District or the Division of Labor Standards Enforcement within forty-five (45) days after receipt of a written request, and no penalty or withholding shall apply to any request satisfied within that period.

defects.title: No hours-of-labor penalty stipulation
defects.why: Section 9.6 states the eight-hour day and the overtime rate but the contract nowhere stipulates that Contractor forfeits $25 per worker per day for work over 8 hours a day or 40 hours a week in violation of the article. The contract must contain that stipulation.
quotes: Workers employed on the Work may be required or permitted to work more than eight (8) hours in any one calendar day or forty (40) hours in any one calendar week only if they are compensated for all hours in excess of those limits at not less than one and one-half (1.5) times the basic rate of pay.

defects.title: Payment bond at 50 percent of the Contract Price
defects.why: Section 10.2 sets the payment bond at 50 percent of the Contract Price. On a public works contract over $25,000 the payment bond must be not less than 100 percent of the contract price.
quotes: a payment bond in a penal sum equal to fifty percent (50%) of the Contract Price, securing payment of all persons furnishing labor, materials, equipment or services for the Work

defects.title: Brand-name pump specification with no substitutions
defects.why: Exhibit B, item B-2 names a single manufacturer and model for the pumps and refuses all substitutions, without the words "or equal" and without reciting any finding. Specifications may not name a product by brand or trade name unless followed by "or equal", subject to exceptions that require a finding.
quotes: Submersible pumps shall be Vortigern Hydraulics Model VH-450 dry-pit submersible units. No substitutions will be considered, and no request to furnish an alternate manufacturer will be reviewed.
